description.value: The Snug holds the distinction of being Victoria's first neighbourhood pub, dating back to 1954, and is now housed within the Oak Bay Beach Hotel on the city's scenic waterfront. Floor-to-ceiling ocean views and an oceanfront patio define the casual coastal atmosphere, while the kitchen draws on seasonal BC produce and pours a healthy selection of local brews on tap. It is a historic and beloved local institution well worth a detour for cyclists riding the Oak Bay shoreline.

No bike parking, water refill, takeout, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
